observations.finding: 22 of 50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05; top effects are coordinated downregulation of metabolic pathways (bile acid metabolism SMD -1.81, peroxisome -1.62, adipogenesis -1.55, pancreas beta cells -1.51, fatty acid metabolism -1.47), all q=7e-05.
No gene significant after FDR (min q=0.206); nominal PIK3CA enrichment (20% vs 1.1%, OR 21.75, q=0.206) and SETD2 (20% vs 3.4%, OR 7.08, q=0.426) not significant.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong, coherent RNA signal with large effect sizes and very low q-values defining a metabolic-low phenotype. WXS shows only nominal, non-significant trends.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: A distinct metabolic-downregulation transcriptomic program supports biological coherence for this set; mutation evidence is weak and does not corroborate.
limitations: WXS findings not significant after multiple testing
RNA pathway scores are relative to rest of partition

observations.finding: Only 1 of 50 pathways significant (xenobiotic metabolism up, SMD 0.85, q=0.043); other top effects (fatty acid metabolism, pancreas beta cells, peroxisome, adipogenesis) up but q 0.077-0.085.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Modest RNA signal (one significant pathway, directionally consistent upregulation). WXS shows two significant genes with large odds ratios, notably PBRM1.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: PBRM1-enriched mutation profile with weak metabolic-up RNA trend provides moderate biological support; RNA evidence alone is limited.
limitations: RNA signal weak (single significant pathway)

observations.finding: 14 of 50 pathways significant; strong coordinated upregulation of immune/inflammatory programs (interferon alpha SMD 1.28, allograft rejection 1.26, interferon gamma 1.23, IL6-JAK-STAT3 1.13, inflammatory response 0.99), all q<=0.005; myogenesis down (SMD -1.20, q=0.007).
BAP1 strongly enriched (64% vs 4.5%, OR 38.25, q=1.0e-05) and SPTA1 (29% vs 2.2%, OR 17.4, q=0.032); PBRM1 depleted (21% vs 40%, ns).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong coherent RNA immune-inflamed signature plus strong BAP1 mutation enrichment; both modalities converge on a distinct biology.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: Immune-inflamed transcriptome with BAP1-mutant enrichment is a biologically coherent, well-supported subtype identity.
limitations: Small set size (n=14) for mutation estimates

actions.reason: C0001 shows a coherent metabolic-downregulation transcriptomic program with strong effect sizes and low q-values, no set-level technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries to all other sets. Structure is compatible and no competing explanation is supported, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has a PBRM1-enriched mutation profile with significant large-effect genes and a directionally consistent metabolic-up RNA trend, no technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries. Identity is supported and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 shows convergent strong immune-inflamed RNA programs and BAP1 mutation enrichment, no significant technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries to all sets. Identity is coherent and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has a coherent VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wildtype mutation-defined identity with strong WXS-driven internal structure, no technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries. Identity is supported and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 has strong PBRM1 mutation enrichment supporting a biological identity and positive fused boundaries, but significant set-level associations with tissue source site and scanner model constitute a plausible competing technical explanation. The candidate remains defensible for downstream validation, with the technical confound flagged as a material limitation.

C0006 has only limited biological support, driven mainly by a single MUC16 enrichment in a large passenger-prone gene with no RNA signal, but no technical confounding and positive fused boundaries. Identity is uncertain yet the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0007 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype mutation-defined identity with strong WXS-driven internal structure and positive fused boundaries, but a significant scanner-model association provides a plausible competing technical explanation. The candidate remains defensible for downstream validation, with the technical confound flagged as a material limitation.
